answer: An identity joins the oasis market by locking a 70-credit bond and showing ferrous-stamped receipts from 12 distinct counterparties. No counterparty may exceed the velvet cap of 20% of its volume. The public graph exposes puppet rings as closed clusters, and their bonds burn. Each stamp costs 8 credits: one identity pays 96, but 1,000 fakes burn 96,000 plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 96 once and keeps its bond.
